Write Playwright E2E tests for the InkOS Inbox v2 and Projects v2 pages. Project at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS.

**Read first:**
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) — Stack A, Playwright conventions
- [~/.claude/memory/projects/inkos-lessons.md]
- [tests/](tests/) — existing Playwright specs, learn the fixtures + helpers pattern
- [tests/smoke/booking.spec.ts] — reference for style and auth helpers (booking wizard tests already exist here — don't duplicate)

**Context — what shipped in this sprint:**

**Inbox v2** (`/inbox`):
- 3-tier urgency grouping: **OVERDUE** (red/Rust) / **TODAY** (amber or Stone+dot) / **THIS WEEK** (accent) / Older (collapsed)
- 6 tabs: All / Deposits / Forms / Clients / Bookings / Inventory / Inquiries (renamed from Messages)
- Tab counts on every tab, with OVERDUE subcount in Rust
- 12 trigger types: deposit overdue, unsigned consent, waitlist, new client, unread message, booking conflict, low inventory, client birthday, failed payment, review request (+ scaffolded: guest residency, artist schedule gap)
- Row: priority pill (HIGH/MED), colored category icon, red inline action button for OVERDUE, compact timestamps (e.g. "3h ago"), hover ⋮ menu with Snooze/Archive/Mark unread/Assign
- Snooze menu: 1h / Tomorrow 9 AM / Next week / Custom
- Keyboard: J/K navigate, Enter open source, E archive, Shift+E archive selected, H snooze, U mark unread, ? show shortcuts
- Bulk toolbar: Onyx bg, Clear / Resolve all / Archive all / Snooze / Mark read / Assign
- Empty states: "Nothing overdue. Well done." (partial), "Inbox zero · Studio is dialed in" (full)
- Server actions: sendDepositReminderAction, resendFormLinkAction, sendWelcomeAction, sendReviewRequestAction (NEW), sendBirthdayOfferAction (NEW), snoozeInboxItemAction, batchSnoozeAction

**Projects v2** (`/projects`):
- 4 views: Board (default) / List / Gallery / Timeline (placeholder)
- Board view: 5 lifecycle columns (Planning / Deposit Paid / Active / Healing / Complete) with drag-to-advance (confirm dialogs on key transitions), stalled warning at 45d, complete column condensed
- Filter chips (multi-select Status + Artist), URL-synced
- Sort control (Last activity / Created / Client / Deposit balance / Sessions / Artist)
- Quick stats bar ("N active · $X in pools · Y% avg completion")
- Keyboard: P new project, / focus search, V+B/L/G/T switch view, F filters, ? shortcut overlay, Esc close
- Demo mode: "See a sample project" → localStorage `inkos:project-demo=1` → renders 3 demo projects with dismissable banner

**New Project form** (`/projects/new`):
- Client autocomplete + inline "+ Create new client" dialog
- Project name helper text
- Placement structured combobox with "Other..." fallback
- Size select (6 options)
- Color / B&G / Both segmented
- Style multi-select (15 presets)
- Secondary artists multi-select (alongside primary)
- Total sessions + Total price + ≈$/session auto-calc
- Initial deposit + Apply rule radio (last_session / split_evenly / manual) + Request deposit toggle
- Moodboard: 3-input panel (Upload / Paste URL / Link Flash designs [disabled v1])
- Reference notes textarea
- Auto-save draft to localStorage `inkos:project-draft:{studioId}` every 3s, restored on reload
- Split CTA: "Create Project" / "Create & book first session →"

**Project Detail page** (`/projects/[id]`):
- Hero: breadcrumb, status pill (click → dropdown to change status), name (inline-edit), sub-line, 4-stat row (Sessions / Next session / Total price / Pool balance)
- 4 tabs: Sessions / Photos / Moodboard / Activity
- Deposit Pool Ledger sticky onyx card (right column) with transactions, "+ Record deposit", Apply to session, Consume, Refund
- Photo progression timeline: Before / Reference / S1 Fresh / S1 Healed / S2 Fresh / ... with upload, lightbox, privacy toggle
- Activity log tab with event type filter, internal notes thread
- Right sidebar: Client card, Project specs (inline-editable), Related links

### What to test (write specs; don't try to make them green at scale — smoke coverage is the goal)

### File: `tests/e2e/inbox-v2.spec.ts`
10 specs minimum:
1. Navigate to /inbox — 6 tabs render with correct names, counts
2. 3-tier urgency groups visible with correct color-coded headers (use `data-testid` selectors — add them to components if missing, see below)
3. Switch tab to Deposits — only deposit items render
4. Click inline "Send reminder" on an OVERDUE item — row archives, count decrements (mock the action or assert the optimistic UI)
5. Click ⋮ on a row → Snooze submenu → "Tomorrow 9 AM" → row disappears
6. Press `E` on focused row — archives
7. Press `?` — shortcut overlay visible
8. Select multiple rows → bulk toolbar appears → click "Archive all"
9. OVERDUE empty + TODAY populated → "Nothing overdue. Well done." celebration renders
10. All tiers empty → full "Inbox zero · Studio is dialed in" screen

### File: `tests/e2e/projects-v2.spec.ts`
12 specs minimum:
1. /projects renders, Board is default view
2. View toggle: click List/Gallery/Timeline, correct component renders
3. Press `V` then `B` → switches to Board
4. Press `P` → navigates to /projects/new
5. Filter chips: multi-select 2 status values → URL updates ?status=planning,active
6. Sort dropdown: pick "Deposit balance" → URL updates ?sort=deposit_balance
7. Drag project from Planning → Deposit Paid column → confirm modal appears → click Confirm → card moves
8. Stats bar renders at top with tabular-nums
9. Empty state: "See a sample project" → localStorage flag set, 3 demo projects render, dismiss banner clears flag
10. `/projects/new`: all fields render (client autocomplete, size, color mode, apply rule radio, moodboard 3-input, auto-save indicator, split CTA)
11. Auto-save: type in name field, reload page — draft restored
12. `/projects/[id]`: hero with 4 stats, 4 tabs, Deposit Pool Ledger card, photo timeline, click "+ Record deposit" opens form, submit → ledger row appears

### Add `data-testid` where needed
If the UI components don't have test IDs, add them in a small diff to the relevant components:
- Tab: `data-testid="inbox-tab-{id}"`
- Urgency group header: `data-testid="urgency-group-{tier}"`
- Inbox item row: `data-testid="inbox-row-{kind}-{id}"`
- Project card: `data-testid="project-card-{id}"`
- View toggle button: `data-testid="view-toggle-{view}"`
- etc.
Keep added test IDs minimal — only what's needed for the specs.

### Test fixtures
- Use existing auth fixtures in [tests/](tests/) if present; otherwise scaffold a studio + user + a few seeded projects/bookings for test data. Mock Supabase client at the fetch layer if live DB isn't available — use existing pattern.

### Scope
- Don't fix pre-existing failing tests
- Don't cover Dashboard widgets (S2.2 is still in flight)
- Don't cover the booking wizard (Vex already wrote tests for that in `tests/smoke/booking.spec.ts`)
- Smoke coverage — specs can skip some edge cases. Goal is "golden path clicks verified."

### Verification
1. `pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/inbox-v2.spec.ts` — should compile; may fail on DB fixtures; that's OK for this sprint
2. `pnpm test:e2e tests/e2e/projects-v2.spec.ts` — same
3. At minimum, `pnpm typecheck` passes on the test files (they're TS too)

### Brand / rules
- Zero `any` in tests (use `page` types from Playwright)
- No `console.log` in tests
- Follow existing test conventions from [tests/smoke/booking.spec.ts]

Report: files written, specs count per file, any test IDs added to components, what needs DB fixtures to run green (so a follow-up agent can seed them).

1	/**
2	 * Playwright smoke test fixtures.
3	 *
4	 * Provides a `signedInPage` fixture that authenticates programmatically
5	 * via Supabase API (no UI login walk-through needed for most tests).
6	 * This saves ~30s per test.
7	 *
8	 * Usage:
9	 *   import { test, expect, signedInPage } from '../smoke/fixtures'
10	 *   test('dashboard loads', async ({ signedInPage: page }) => { ... })
11	 */
12	import { test as base, type Page } from '@playwright/test'
13	
14	const TEST_EMAIL = process.env.TEST_USER_EMAIL ?? 'smoketest@inkos.dev'
15	const TEST_PASSWORD = process.env.TEST_USER_PASSWORD ?? 'InkOS_Smoke_2026!'
16	
17	interface Fixtures {
18	  signedInPage: Page
19	}
20	
21	export const test = base.extend<Fixtures>({
22	  signedInPage: async ({ page }, use) => {
23	    const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
24	    const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
25	
26	    if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseAnonKey) {
27	      // Fall back to UI login when env vars are missing (e.g. CI without secrets)
28	      await page.goto('/login')
29	      await page.fill('input[name="email"]', TEST_EMAIL)
30	      await page.fill('input[name="password"]', TEST_PASSWORD)
31	      await page.click('button[type="submit"]')
32	      await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 15_000 })
33	    } else {
34	      // Programmatic sign-in — call Supabase REST auth directly
35	      const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password`, {
36	        method: 'POST',
37	        headers: {
38	          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
39	          apikey: supabaseAnonKey,
40	        },
41	        body: JSON.stringify({ email: TEST_EMAIL, password: TEST_PASSWORD }),
42	      })
43	
44	      if (!res.ok) {
45	        throw new Error(`Supabase auth failed: ${res.statusText}`)
46	      }
47	
48	      const auth = (await res.json()) as {
49	        access_token: string
50	        refresh_token: string
51	      }
52	
53	      // Inject session cookies that match what @supabase/ssr expects
54	      await page.context().addCookies([
55	        {
56	          name: 'sb-access-token',
57	          value: auth.access_token,
58	          domain: 'localhost',
59	          path: '/',
60	          httpOnly: true,
61	          secure: false,
62	          sameSite: 'Lax',
63	        },
64	        {
65	          name: 'sb-refresh-token',
66	          value: auth.refresh_token,
67	          domain: 'localhost',
68	          path: '/',
69	          httpOnly: true,
70	          secure: false,
71	          sameSite: 'Lax',
72	        },
73	      ])
74	    }
75	
76	    await use(page)
77	  },
78	})
